items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I made some things for him... I just was freelancing. I made these things, and he liked them, you know, and he had a great personnel

ctx.x: This was later, wasn't it? Was this maybe in the '50's even?

This was around the '50's because he was doing a lot of one nighters in the ballrooms and whatnot, and, of course, Ralph became quite popular, and he did some good things. Have you heard about that guy lately?
